Once both materials are gathered, the agent can build a floor using those materials. Finally, with building skills demonstrated and materials available, the agent builds a chair on top of the completed floor. This creates a logical construction workflow: gather materials → build foundation → build furniture.

edges.reason: Building the floor requires black_concrete blocks that must first be located in the environment
Red concrete powder is mined and used as a secondary material for the decorative floor pattern

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the black concrete 2x2x2 structure (centered at spawn-relative 5.5, 0.5, 5.5 in the SE corner) and face it, demonstrating they have located it. Max distance of 8 blocks and 60° facing tolerance models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_concrete_powder drops the item into the player's inventory. Although the player is given 16 via /give at scene setup, the mine_block event would be ideal but is not a supported rule type. Instead, we check inventory_has with min_count=17 — since the player starts with exactly 16, having 17+ proves they mined at least one block from the world. This reliably detects the mining action.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. The player must place blocks on top of the stone platform (y=0 layer, which is one above the stone at y=-1) within the 5x5 area. Checking for at least 4 blocks of either black_concrete or red_concrete_powder placed in a generous box covering the platform area. Box extends ±3 in X and ±3 around center Z=5 to be generous, and y=0 to y=1 to catch blocks placed on the surface.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a build/place task. A Minecraft chair is minimally one oak_stairs block placed as a seat. The player must place at least 1 oak_stairs block within the floor/building area. Box covers the stone platform region with generous bounds (±5 XZ, y=0 to y=3) to accommodate chairs built on top of the floor layer.

scene_description: A flat grass platform with three key features: (1) A 2x2x2 black concrete structure at ~5-6, ~0-1, ~5-6 (SE of spawn) that the player must find; (2) An enlarged cluster of 13 red concrete powder blocks at ~-5/-7, ~0-1, ~-4/-6 (NW of spawn) that the player must mine; (3) A 5x5 stone platform at ~-2 to ~2, ~-1, ~3 to ~7 (ahead of spawn) designated as the floor-building area. Player inventory includes oak_stairs, oak_slabs, black_concrete, red_concrete_powder, and a diamond_pickaxe.
task_text: First, find the black concrete structure nearby. Then mine the red concrete powder blocks from the cluster. Next, build a decorative floor on the stone platform using the concrete materials. Finally, build a chair on top of your completed floor using the oak stairs in your inventory.
design_notes: Scene is compact (~16x16 blocks). Black concrete is SE of spawn (+X,+Z), red concrete powder is NW (-X,-Z), and the building platform is directly ahead (+Z). Player has all materials in inventory plus extras obtainable from mining. The stone platform clearly marks where the floor should be built. Chair is built with oak_stairs (seat). Red concrete powder cluster is 13 blocks (9 ground + 4 upper) for high visibility. The /fill air command clears trees and natural terrain above the platform to ensure clear sightlines between all scene elements.
